_comment: allergy_groups: patient-stated allergy -> generic medicines in that family. cross_reactivity: related families that carry a lower but real risk.

Cephalosporin.reason: Cephalosporins share a beta-lactam ring with penicillins, so a smaller proportion of penicillin-allergic patients also react to them.

NSAID.reason: Other NSAIDs work through the same pathway and can trigger the same reaction in aspirin-sensitive patients.
